description: This file defines the EmpEmergencyContact class, representing an employee's emergency contact information within an HR management system. It uses Doctrine ORM annotations for database mapping and includes properties such as contact name, relationship, and phone numbers, along with getter and setter methods.

classes.name: EmpEmergencyContact
classes.description: Entity class representing an employee's emergency contact, including personal details and phone numbers, mapped to the 'hs_hr_emp_emergency_contacts' database table.

methods.name: getEmployee
methods.description: Returns the Employee object associated with this emergency contact.

methods.name: setEmployee
methods.description: Associates an Employee object with this emergency contact.

methods.name: getSeqNo
methods.description: Returns the sequence number of this emergency contact record.

methods.name: setSeqNo
methods.description: Sets the sequence number for this emergency contact.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the name of the emergency contact.

methods.name: setName
methods.description: Sets the name of the emergency contact.

methods.name: getRelationship
methods.description: Returns the relationship of the emergency contact to the employee.

methods.name: setRelationship
methods.description: Sets the relationship of the emergency contact to the employee.

methods.name: getHomePhone
methods.description: Returns the home phone number of the emergency contact.

methods.name: setHomePhone
methods.description: Sets the home phone number of the emergency contact.

methods.name: getMobilePhone
methods.description: Returns the mobile phone number of the emergency contact.

methods.name: setMobilePhone
methods.description: Sets the mobile phone number of the emergency contact.

methods.name: getOfficePhone
methods.description: Returns the office phone number of the emergency contact.

methods.name: setOfficePhone
methods.description: Sets the office phone number of the emergency contact.
